status_note: Pinned from the Gate 1a/1b evidence (kept outside the repository). The SHA-256 and size are those of the signed release manifest (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5-SHA512, signing key SPKI SHA-256 89a24e2e18d2f8fa4627a0a47cf76c3682aef237b60d2cd115d6f5202e2e9896, verified offline) AND of the bytes actually downloaded; they are identical. Static analysis only: ELF 64-bit little-endian x86-64, dynamically linked, interpreter /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, needs librt, libc, ld-linux, libpthread, libdl and libm, highest required GLIBC version 2.17 (Ubuntu 22.04 provides 2.35), no libstdc++. The binary has NOT been executed: runtime compatibility, including Rosetta and CPU features (it declares no x86 ISA requirements), is unverified until Gate 3.
max_binary_note: Hard refusal above this. The verified Linux x64 binary is 373019152 bytes (355.74 MiB), 44.26 MiB under this ceiling and 60.26 MiB under the 416 MiB /opt/aiep tmpfs. The ceiling is unchanged. See docs/M2_GATE0_NOTES.md for the tmpfs and memory arithmetic.
to_verify_after_download: the binary runs under Rosetta in the agent container, as the unprivileged agent user, from a read-only root and noexec HOME and /tmp (Gate 3)
